item.title: Full moon shining over Marion County
item.description: Check out this recent photo of the full moon shining over Marion County. Thanks to Amanda Mitchem for sharing!

item.title: I think trains in Ocala shouldn't be in city limits
item.description: "The city has a problem with CSX: They don't take care of the tracks and we don't need them going by businesses and homes in Ocala which could spill dangerous chemicals and keep people out of their homes for weeks on end. I personally don't like them going by my neighborhood because they cause sink holes and damaging foundations in this area, and whoever was the rocket scientist who cleared them to run extra heavy trains needs mental help." - An Ocala resident shares his opinion.

item.title: Ocala woman who eats raw beef and pork featured on TLC addiction show
item.description: An Ocala woman who eats raw beef and pork was just featured on a series about strange addictions on TLC, saying she consumes two pounds of raw meat every day.

item.title: Ida Delores Taylor
item.description: Ida Taylor enjoyed shopping, traveling, and spending time with her family and friends, especially the grands and great-grands.

item.title: Diego Alonso Palacio
item.description: Diego Palacio will be remembered as a man who lived with purpose and passion. His impact on his community, his friends, and most importantly, his family, will be felt for generations to come.

item.title: Navy releases weekly bomb training schedule at Ocala National Forest
item.description: The U.S. Navy has announced its upcoming training schedule for the Pinecastle Range Complex, advising residents and visitors in the Ocala National Forest to prepare for military aircraft activity this week.

item.title: Janette Joyce Gaydovchik
item.description: Janette Gaydovchik will be remembered as a devoted founding member of St Thomas the Apostle Orthodox Church, where her faith and dedication helped shape the parish community.

item.title: Ocala nurse's license suspended for pointing loaded gun at boyfriend's head
item.description: An Ocala nurse has had her license temporarily suspended by the state following her arrest in July for allegedly pointing a loaded gun at her boyfriend and threatening to shoot him in the head.

item.title: Dennis James Havener
item.description: Dennis Havener loved nothing more than gathering with his beloved wife and their friends for long dinners filled with laughter and storytelling.

item.title: 18-year-old allegedly steals video game consoles, LEGO sets from Marion of Marion
item.description: An 18-year-old Marion County man is facing multiple felony charges after he allegedly stole video game consoles, video games, and LEGO sets from several vendor booths at a local flea market.
